headline: South Africa October New Vehicle Sales Increase 10.4% Year-on-Year
summary: South Africa sold 61,890 new vehicles in October, marking a 10.4% increase from a year earlier as exports rose 6.3% to 38,117.
why: Auto sales and export figures serve as key indicators of consumer demand and manufacturing sector health in South Africa's economy.

impacts.name: South Africa
impacts.why: Higher vehicle sales and exports indicate stronger domestic consumer activity and manufacturing performance.
